description: This file defines a class 'AzureTableStorageGrainStorageProviderBuilder' that implements the 'IProviderBuilder<ISiloBuilder>' interface. It configures Azure Table Storage as a grain storage provider within an Orleans silo, setting up connection options based on configuration settings.

classes.name: AzureTableStorageGrainStorageProviderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class that configures Azure Table Storage as a grain storage provider for Orleans Silo.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to use Azure Table Storage for grain storage, setting parameters like table name, connection string, and serializer based on configuration.
